reviewed_by: Manual review against Binary Ninja, Radare2 disassembly and the 12-case PE32 differential report

checks.name: function_identity
checks.rationale: The reviewed entry is retail VA 0x00505E40; BN and Radare2 CFG artifacts are independently rooted at this exact address and agree at CFG score 1.0.

checks.name: abi_and_argument
checks.rationale: Retail begins by loading the single cdecl stack argument into EAX and then reads the context fields at offsets +0xBC, +0x68 and +0xE4. Candidate entry TextureModifier_Push takes one context pointer.

checks.name: validation_branches
checks.rationale: Retail rejects a negative index and a zero source-row element before modifying push state. Candidate has the same checks. The differential covers negative/minimum index and disabled rows.

checks.name: normal_push_effects
checks.rationale: On a valid row and stack count below 20, retail stores context[+0xE4] into the 20-slot global stack at 0x00B97DA0, folds the incremented value into mask 0x00BA5060, increments count 0x00B97DF8, sets context[+0xDC], and returns the incremented value. Candidate implementation performs those corresponding operations; passing cases push-zero, push-value, push-last-slot, push-wrap and push-wide-value compare context and global state.

checks.name: full_stack_error_path
checks.rationale: At count >= 20 with a valid row, retail calls Error_Show with "Too many items in texture modifier stack!" and enters the self-loop at 0x00505E76. The runner models only the Error_Show call boundary and compares fatal-loop outcome for two full-stack cases.

checks.name: scope_and_limits
checks.rationale: This review authorizes only the bounded controlled PE32 fixture cases in texture_modifier_push_diff_runner.py; it does not establish natural game-loop reachability, renderer behavior, null/unmapped pointers, arbitrary aliasing, or every caller integration.

checks.name: argument_mapping
checks.rationale: Retail receives one cdecl context pointer; the implementation exposes one context pointer argument and accesses the documented context fields.

checks.name: constants_and_scaling
checks.rationale: The checked threshold is stack count 20; source row uses index*3 DWORDs; selected field offsets and global VAs are taken from retail instructions, not inferred from other natives.

checks.name: memory_layout_and_access
checks.rationale: Only controlled mapped PE32 context and global storage are exercised; the runner compares the context bytes and three global regions. Arbitrary pointer aliasing/layout is excluded.

checks.name: calls_and_side_effects
checks.rationale: On success the routine updates its flag, modifier stack, packed mask and count. At capacity it calls Error_Show; the runner intercepts that call boundary and tests the caller fatal loop.

checks.name: return_and_error_paths
checks.rationale: The differential compares context-pointer return when disabled, incremented integer result on push, and the fatal-loop outcome at capacity.

checks.name: floating_point_semantics
checks.rationale: This native uses integer fields, bit operations and pointer values; there is no floating-point operation in its retail body.

runtime_contract.note: The runner executes the retail PE32 in Unicorn and a separately compiled candidate PE32 with identical controlled fixtures. Error_Show is modeled at a boundary; no natural game wiring or renderer parity is claimed.

limitations: Only 12 deterministic fixtures; no exhaustive context values.
Controlled valid mapped pointers; arbitrary aliasing and null/unmapped-pointer behavior are not tested.
Error_Show body is not compared; the caller message and fatal self-loop are observed.
Natural level runtime reachability and texture rendering effects are not covered.
